summary: Coya Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a press release on October 14, 2026, announcing an open-label extension of the Phase 2/3 ALSTARS Trial (NCT07161999) for COYA 302 in ALS, expected to begin November 2026 as the first cohort completes 48 weeks of treatment. The company will prioritize ALS development, delaying a planned Phase 2 FTD trial from 2H 2026 to 2027. Cash runway guidance is unchanged, funding operations into 2H 2027 past anticipated ALSTARS topline data. No deal, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; this is an ordinary clinical-update current report, not a special situation.
